section.name: The Timer
section.t: The publication pipeline validation enforces the following timer constraint:

li.t: 30-day timer: A document MUST be finalized within 30 days from entering the AUTH48 or equivalent state.
Once the timer has ended, the document SHALL be published.

section.t: With explicit authorization of the IESG, the 30-day timer can be extended by maximum of ten days overall.
